title: Tree and Binary Tree Concept Quiz
description: A quick check to review tree and binary tree basics.

questions.questionText: In a tree, what is the root?

options.text: The top node of the tree
Any node with no parent and no value
The last item in a Python list
A node that must have exactly three children

questions.explanation: The root is the top node of a tree.

questions.questionText: What is the output of the following code?
questions.codeSnippet:
class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, value):
        self.value = value
        self.left = None
        self.right = None

root = TreeNode("A")
root.left = TreeNode("B")
root.right = TreeNode("C")

print(root.left.value)
questions.explanation: root.left points to the node with value B, so the output is B.
